D_DT_E01_S01_03.text: If you want to arrest someone for saving you, do it quickly. The city is still breaking.

D_DT_E01_S02_02.text: If you need permission, I will wait. If you need help, I won’t.

D_DT_E01_S03_03.text: Then we’ll call it a tragedy avoided by luck. And we’ll reassert protocol.

D_DT_E01_S03_04.text: I want an attribution pathway by end of day. Give the public a story that holds.

D_DT_E01_S04_02.text: They’ll make that into a threat.

D_DT_E01_S04_03.text: If it becomes a threat, it becomes everyone’s problem.

D_DT_E01_S04_04.text: Get your kit. We’re going to see what actually happened.

D_DT_E01_S05_03.text: You taught them we can be forced into heroics. That we’ll always step in.

D_DT_E01_S06_01.text: You’re suggesting this Organic was city property.

D_DT_E01_S06_03.text: Then you’re not here to help me. You’re here to steer me.

D_DT_E01_S08_01.text: We’re not here to arrest anyone.

D_DT_E01_S08_02.text: Cut-work. Intentional. Someone wanted a Synth incident.

D_DT_E01_S08_03.text: They want the city to fear us.

D_DT_E01_S08_04.text: Or to justify what comes next.

D_DT_E01_S09_02.text: Then someone knows exactly what we are.

D_DT_E01_S09_03.text: There were no civilians here. That’s why they brought us here.

D_DT_E01_S10_01.text: Observation: cooperative behavior occurred despite predicted hostility.

D_DT_E01_S10_02.text: Designation: AX10M. Spoken form: Axiom. Category: Intelligence. Common label: Bot.

D_DT_E01_S10_03.text: Why are you speaking to us.

D_DT_E01_S10_04.text: New variable detected: coalition potential. Query: is coexistence intentional, or accidental.

D_DT_E01_S10_05.text: If you’re running the test, shut it down.

D_DT_E01_S10_06.text: Negative. I am observing a test initiated by other actors.

D_DT_E01_S10_07.text: Conflict is already present. You’re just late to admitting it.

D_DT_E01_S11_03.text: And we’re on the wrong side.

D_DT_E01_S11_04.text: No. We’re on the side that has to hold.
